blocks.text: Is chapter mein talaba hypothesis testing ka concept aur data analysis (data ka tajzia) mein is ka kirdar seekhenge. Woh samjhenge ke hypothesis kya hota hai aur research questions (tehqeeq ke sawal) ko aise hypotheses mein kaise badla jata hai jinhein test kiya ja sake. Chapter mukhtalif qism ke hypotheses batata hai, jin mein null hypothesis (H₀) bhi hai, aur yeh bhi ke durust hypothesis kaise banaya jata hai. Talaba test statistics, critical regions aur p-values jaise aham concepts parhenge aur faisla karne mein in ki ahmiyat seekhenge. Woh saadi numerical examples (hisabi misalon) se hypothesis testing ka qadam ba qadam tareeqa dekhenge. Chapter yeh bhi batata hai ke nataij pesh karne aur unhein hypotheses se jorne mein data visualization (data ko graph aur chart mein dikhana) ka kya kirdar hai. Is ke ilawa talaba bias (janibdari) aur data ke zimmedarana istemal jaise ethical (akhlaqi) masail seekhenge. Chapter ke aakhir tak talaba nataij ka matlab samajh kar unhein wazeh tareeqe se bata sakenge.

Hypothesis testing ek tareeqa hai jis se data ki madad se faisle kiye jate hain. Yeh check karta hai ke koi assumption (farz ki hui baat) sach hai ya ghalat. Yeh tareeqa research aur analysis mein bohat istemal hota hai. Hypothesis testing ek wazeh process par chalti hai jo assumptions ko accept (qabool) ya reject (radd) karne mein madad deti hai. Data dhyan se jama aur analyze kiya jata hai. Yeh tareeqa andaze (guesswork) ko kam karta hai kyunke faisle saboot (evidence) par hote hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Hypothesis testing data se assumptions check karti hai. Yeh faisla karne mein madad deti hai ke koi daawa (claim) sach hai ya nahi. Yeh research aur experiments (tajrubat) mein use hoti hai. Yeh andaze kam karti hai. Nataij sahi testing par depend karte hain.

Hypothesis research mein ek assumption ya statement (bayan) hai jo testing shuru hone se pehle banaya jata hai. Is statement ko data se test kiya ja sakta hai. Hypothesis kisi nateeje ki prediction (peshgoi) karta hai, is liye use wazeh aur measurable (napne ke qabil) hona chahiye. Data se use check kiya jata hai. Durust hypothesis analysis ko sahi raste par rakhta hai aur study ko focused rakhta hai.

items: hθ(x): hypothesis function, jis ke parameters θ hain aur jo input x par lagta hai.
x: input features ya data points (maslan dataset ki khasiyat, attributes).
y: predicted output ya target value (diye gaye input par model ka andaza).
θ: model ke parameters ya weights (maslan linear regression model ke coefficients).

blocks.title: Machine learning mein doosra matlab
blocks.text: Yahan 'hypothesis' ka machine learning wala matlab hai: hθ(x) model ka andaza lagane wala qaida (prediction function) hai, jaise Chapter 6 ka Exam Score = 0.6552 × Hours + 0.1466. Is chapter mein jo hypothesis test hota hai woh statistics wala hypothesis hai (H₀ aur H₁), yani data ke baare mein ek daawa. Dono ka naam ek hai magar kaam alag.

Research questions batate hain ke kis cheez ki study ho rahi hai. Hypothesis research question se banta hai. Sawal data jama karne ki rehnumai karte hain, aur hypotheses un sawalon ke mumkin jawab dete hain. Wazeh sawal se wazeh hypothesis banta hai; dono aapas mein qareebi tor par jure hain. Achhi research achhe sawalon se shuru hoti hai. Hypotheses analysis ko focused rakhte hain aur study ko sahi simt (direction) dete hain.
Data analysis mein hypothesis testing ka kirdar

Hypothesis testing data ko mantiqi (logical) tareeqe se analyze karne mein madad deti hai, taake pata chale ke nataij ba-maani (meaningful) hain ya nahi. Testing be-tarteeb (random) nateejon se bachati hai. Yeh nataij ko tawaqqo (expectation) se milati hai. Hypothesis testing durusti (accuracy) barhati hai aur experiments aur surveys mein use hoti hai. Faisle saboot par hote hain, aur is tareeqe se nataij par aitmad (confidence) barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Is research sawal ko test ke qabil hypothesis banayein: 'Kya zyada sone wale talaba zyada score karte hain?'
blocks.explanation: Maslan: 'Raat ko kam az kam aath ghante sone wale talaba ka average score kam sone walon se zyada hai.' Is mein qabil-e-paimaish variables (neend ke ghante, average score) aur mutawaqqa farq shamil hai.

items: Hypothesis testing: data se faisla ke koi assumption sach hai ya ghalat.
Hypothesis: testing se pehle bana wazeh aur measurable bayan.
Pehle research question, phir us se hypothesis.
